notablePrerequisites: An opponent lost life this turn.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Famished Foragers, adding {C}{C}.
Famished Foragers dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Famished Foragers from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use Famished Foragers' ability to infinitely rummage.
